name: ABC Automation DataPAC 3500 — Oil Storage Tank
description: Tank battery RTU configuration for the DataPAC 3500 monitoring an atmospheric oil storage tank. The DataPAC 3500 is a solar-powered, cellular RTU commonly deployed at unmanned lease locations.

tag_definitions.name: Tank Level
tag_definitions.description: Float or ultrasonic level transmitter output in feet from tank bottom.

tag_definitions.name: Tank Temperature
tag_definitions.description: RTD or thermocouple inserted at mid-tank elevation for fluid temperature.

tag_definitions.name: Tank Pressure
tag_definitions.description: Vapor recovery unit (VRU) inlet pressure or atmospheric vent pressure. Zero on open-top tanks.

tag_definitions.name: Net Volume (Barrels)
tag_definitions.description: Calculated net barrels from DataPAC strapping table and VCF correction. Derived from TK_LVL and TK_TEMP.

tag_definitions.name: Gross Volume (Barrels)
tag_definitions.description: Gross barrels at observed temperature from strapping table only. No VCF applied.

tag_definitions.name: API Gravity
tag_definitions.description: Crude API gravity entered as a fixed site parameter in the DataPAC configuration. Used for VCF table lookup.

tag_definitions.name: Battery Voltage
tag_definitions.description: RTU battery bus voltage. Solar-charged 12 V system; alarm below 11.8 V.

tag_definitions.name: Solar Panel Voltage
tag_definitions.description: Solar panel open-circuit voltage. Used to confirm panel health and daytime charging.

tag_definitions.name: Cellular Signal Strength
tag_definitions.description: Cellular modem RSSI in dBm. Values above -85 dBm indicate reliable connectivity.
